scripts.text:
[Tine]
The legend says that on 14th February... on the Day of Saint Valentine...
Only in Run-Midgard kingdom...
scripts.translation:
[蒂內]
傳說每到2月14日...也就是情人節...
在盧恩·米德加茲王國...

scripts.text:
[Tine]
Some married chocolate lovers almost double their experience at trainings!
But everything isn't so simply...
scripts.translation:
[蒂內]
有些喜歡巧克力的已婚人士，在訓練時能獲得將近雙倍的經驗值！
不過，事情可沒那麼簡單...

scripts.text: Wow! Tell me more!
scripts.translation: 哇！告訴我更多！

scripts.text: Marri... what?
scripts.translation: 結...結婚？

scripts.text:
[Tine]
Are you a single?
Today is a great date to ask your beloved half for marriage!
scripts.translation:
[蒂內]
你是單身嗎？
今天是向你的另一半求婚的好日子！

scripts.text:
[Tine]
The Marriage fee is ridiculous low these days!
scripts.translation:
[蒂內]
現在的結婚費用低得離譜！

scripts.text:
[Tine]
The magic effect possesses only handmade chocolate from grand-grand-grand-whoever recipes!
scripts.translation:
[蒂內]
只有用曾曾曾...不知傳了多少代的祖傳秘方做出的手工巧克力，才有這種魔法效果！

scripts.text:
[Tine]
It being known that Black Handmade Chocolate works on married guys... And the White one on the married girls!
If you lose your wedding ring... then alas, it won't work on you.
scripts.translation:
[蒂內]
聽說黑色手工巧克力對已婚男性有效，白色手工巧克力則對已婚女性有效！
要是弄丟了結婚戒指...唉，那就沒用了。

scripts.text:
[Tine]
On having a Chocolate, you should put off your ring then... put it back... And if your partner is online, then magic would last till the next hour!
scripts.translation:
[蒂內]
拿到巧克力後，你應該摘下戒指...然後再戴上...如果你的伴侶線上，魔法效果將持續到下一個整點！

scripts.text:
[Tine]
Rumors bark that guys and gals have +50% EXP bonuses on FIVE different races of the monsters... Excluding bloody bosses, of course.
scripts.translation:
[蒂內]
據說男女雙方打五種不同種族的魔物時，能獲得50%的經驗值加成...當然，那些該死的Boss可不算。

scripts.text:
[Tine]
There's a famous confectioner in the Castle of Prontera! He's the one you need.
scripts.translation:
[蒂內]
普隆德拉城堡裡有一位著名的糖果師！你需要找的就是他。

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
Guess what I've got?
A tasty treat not easily found in Midgard....
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
猜猜我有什麼？
在米德加茲可不容易找到這樣的美味...

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
Chocolate!
That's right, don't you love chocolate.... I do.
And you are in luck, because I'm selling them for only 5,000 zeny a piece!
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
巧克力！
沒錯，你喜歡巧克力吧...反正我喜歡。
你可走運了，我這裡每塊只賣5,000 Zeny！

scripts.text: I want some chocolate!
scripts.translation: 我想要巧克力！

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
You don't want any chocolate?
I'm telling you! You'll regret it!
You better get some now... you won't come across Chocolate like this ever again!
Think it over and visit me again sometime.
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
你不想買巧克力嗎？
我告訴你！你會後悔的！
你最好現在買一些...你再也遇不到像這樣的巧克力了！
好好考慮一下，改天再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
Hah!
I knew it!
But I can't sell you more than 5 at once....but, if you really need more....
you can come back again.
So how many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
哈！我就知道！
不過，我一次最多隻能賣5塊。想多買一些的話，再來找我就行...
你要幾塊？

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
There you go!
You can give that to someone as a gift, or enjoy it yourself!
Mmm....sweet chocolate...
Visit me anytime...!
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
給你！
你可以把它作為禮物送給別人，或者自己享用！
嗯...甜甜的巧克力...
隨時歡迎再來...

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
I'm sorry but I can't give you that many.
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
抱歉，我不能給你那麼多。

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
I'm sorry but it seems you can't afford to buy these of me.
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
抱歉，看來你買不起我的巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
You know what? The chocolate that my boyfriend sells are from me!
I made them by myself. Now I need some Milk for my special White Chocolate.
scripts.translation:
[傑妮]
你知道嗎？我男朋友賣的巧克力都是我親手做的！
現在我需要一些牛奶，來做特製的白色情人巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
You know ... In certain countries, there's a tradition of presenting chocolates to a person that you love...
They call it ^3355FFValentine's Day^000000.
scripts.translation:
[傑妮]
你知道嗎...在某些國家，有向心愛的人贈送巧克力的傳統...
他們稱之為^3355FF情人節^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
So I gave him my delicious chocolate...
And then he made me cook a lot more...
And now he is selling them to everyone.
I guess he really enjoyed it.
But, I do feel good when people buy something I have made.
scripts.translation:
[傑妮]
我把自己做的美味巧克力送給了他...
結果他讓我又做了好多，現在還把它們賣給大家。
看來他真的很喜歡。
不過，看到有人願意買我做的東西，我也挺開心的。

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
It would be great if you bought some too...
I will be making white chocolates for a while so...
scripts.translation:
[傑妮]
如果你也買一些就好了...
我最近會一直做白色巧克力，所以...

scripts.text: I want some white chocolate!
scripts.translation: 我想要一些白色巧克力！

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
You don't like white chocolate?
Then buy some Stephen's black one!
scripts.translation:
[傑妮]
你不喜歡白色巧克力？
那就買斯蒂芬的黑色巧克力吧！

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
I can't sell you more than 5 at once....but, if you really need more....
you can come back again.
So how many do you want? 1 portion is 4500z + 1 Milk.
scripts.translation:
[傑妮]
我一次最多隻能賣5塊。想多買一些的話，再來找我就行...
你要幾塊？每份需要4,500 Zeny和1瓶牛奶。

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
There you go!
You can give that to someone as a gift, or enjoy it yourself!
Mmm... sweet chocolate...
Visit me anytime...!
scripts.translation:
[傑妮]
給你！
可以送人，也可以自己享用！
嗯...甜甜的巧克力...
隨時歡迎再來...！

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
I'm sorry but I can't give you that many.
scripts.translation:
[傑妮]
抱歉，我不能給你那麼多。

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
I'm sorry but it seems you can't afford to buy these of me.
scripts.translation:
[傑妮]
抱歉，看來你買不起我的巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
You need {0} Milk for {1} portions of my special White Chocolate...
scripts.translation:
[傑妮]
想買{1}份特製白色情人巧克力，需要{0}瓶牛奶...

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Yes? What can I cook for you?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾·奧爾良]
嗯？想讓我給你做什麼？

scripts.text: Black handmade Chocolate, please
scripts.translation: 請給我黑色的手工巧克力

scripts.text: I want a White handmade Chocolate...
scripts.translation: 我想要白色的手工巧克力...

scripts.text: I'm lost, sorry to bother you.
scripts.translation: 我迷路了，抱歉打擾

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Well, I just might be able to fulfill your needs...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾·奧爾良]
嗯，我或許能滿足你的需求...

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
I'm sorry you do not have enough Chocolate Bars to do this.
They say Stephen from Alberta used to sell good Chocolate.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾·奧爾良]
抱歉，你的巧克力棒數量不足，無法進行製作。
聽說艾爾貝塔的斯蒂芬以前賣過很好的巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
I'm sorry you do not have enough Chocolate Bars to do this.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾·奧爾良]
抱歉，你的巧克力棒數量不足，無法進行製作。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
You got 3 pieces of pure chocolate I see.
Give them to me...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾·奧爾良]
我看到你有3塊純巧克力。
把它們給我...

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Ok, now I will only create my special handmade chocolates if you promise to use it wisely.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾·奧爾良]
好，不過你得答應我好好使用它，我才會給你做特製手工巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
....Hmmmmmm.....
Well...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾·奧爾良]
...嗯...
好吧...

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Here.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾·奧爾良]
給你。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Here.
I hope you give it to someone special, because its a special chocolate.
As you know... only I can create this.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾·奧爾良]
給你。
我希望你把它送給特別的人，因為這是特別的巧克力。
你也知道...只有我能做出這種巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Enjoy.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾·奧爾良]
請享用。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Well, I just might be able to fulfill your needs...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾·奧爾良]
嗯，我或許能滿足你的需求...

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
I'm sorry you do not have enough White Chocolate Bars to do this.
They say Jainie from Alberta used to sell good White Chocolate.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾·奧爾良]
抱歉，你的白色情人巧克力數量不足，無法進行製作。
聽說艾爾貝塔的傑妮以前賣過很好的白色情人巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
I'm sorry you do not have enough White Chocolate Bars to do this.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾·奧爾良]
抱歉，你的白色情人巧克力數量不足，無法進行製作。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
You got 3 pieces of pure white chocolate I see.
Give them to me...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾·奧爾良]
我看到你有3塊純白色巧克力。
把它們給我...

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Ok, now I will only create my special handmade chocolates if you promise to use it wisely.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾·奧爾良]
好，不過你得答應我好好使用它，我才會給你做特製手工巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
....Hmmmmmm.....
Well...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾·奧爾良]
...嗯...
好吧...

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Here.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾·奧爾良]
給你。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Here.
I hope you give it to someone special, because its a special chocolate.
As you know... only I can create this.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾·奧爾良]
給你。
我希望你把它送給特別的人，因為這是特別的巧克力。
你也知道...只有我能做出這種巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Enjoy.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾·奧爾良]
請享用。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Oh.. well, if you want me to make some of my special handmade Chocolate....
You will need to give me at least ^0000FF 3 Chocolates^000000 or ^0000FF 3 White Chocolates^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾·奧爾良]
哦...想讓我做特製手工巧克力的話...
至少要給我^0000FF 3塊巧克力^000000或^0000FF 3塊白色情人巧克力^000000。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
That's right, only ^0000FF 3 Chocolates^000000 or ^0000FF 3 White Chocolates^000000.
Bring them to me and you'll get what you came for.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾·奧爾良]
沒錯，就是 ^0000FF 3 塊巧克力^000000 或 ^0000FF 3 塊白色情人巧克力^000000。
把它們帶給我，你就能得到你想要的東西。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
See You.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾·奧爾良]
再見。
